nodes.description: Private uint256 secret number that determines the winning guess; written by shuffle and read by guess.
Public uint256 storing the timestamp of the last guess (set to now).
Public address that owns the contract and is authorized to call kill.
Dynamic array of Player structs recording every guesser address and value sent.
Constant address 0xc316F2bbcCeE013472d2f709414602cF7Fea6007 that receives 20% of balance on kill.
Constructor setting owner = msg.sender and calling shuffle to initialize secretNumber.
Payable guess function: validates number, records player, pays out entire balance to msg.sender on a correct guess, then reshuffles.
Internal function setting secretNumber from keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender) modulo 10 plus 1 (weak randomness).
Owner-only function that splits the contract balance 20% to megaman and 80% to owner.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, player, randomness seed and transfer recipient.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used via now and block.timestamp for the lastPlayed field and the random seed.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) external value transfer performed before the state update in shuffle; reentrancy-exposed.
megaman.transfer((balance*20)/100) external transfer of 20% of the balance.
owner.transfer((balance*80)/100) external transfer of 80% of the balance.
Arithmetic (balance*20)/100 and (balance*80)/100 splitting the balance for payout.
User-supplied guess value restricted to 0..10 by require.
Local Player struct holding msg.sender and msg.value, pushed into players.
Local uint256 capturing address(this).balance inside kill.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient of address(this).balance via transfer, allowing the caller to re-enter the contract.
Constructor assigns owner directly from msg.sender, granting unrestricted ownership to the deployer.
msg.sender is packed into the keccak256 seed for the secret number.
block.timestamp is used as the randomness seed, so miners can bias secretNumber.
lastPlayed is set to now, making the recorded play time miner-influenceable.
secretNumber equality check gates the payout transfer to msg.sender.
The number parameter is validated by require inside guess.
The user-controlled guess decides whether the contract performs the full-balance transfer.
msg.sender is the caller and recorded player of guess.
guess calls shuffle after every play to refresh secretNumber.
Constructor calls shuffle to initialize secretNumber.
The owner state variable is compared against the caller to authorize kill.
The locally read balance funds the megaman transfer.
The locally read balance funds the owner transfer.
The (balance*20)/100 arithmetic result is the amount passed to megaman.transfer.
The local player struct is pushed into the players array.
The transfer to msg.sender executes before shuffle updates secretNumber, so the recipient can callback into guess and win again.

normalization_plan.reason: The number parameter is only meaningful inside guess, so it should be folded into the guess function node.
The local player struct is constructed and pushed solely within guess and has no standalone identity.
The local balance variable is a temporary copy of address(this).balance used only inside kill.
